__inputs.name: DS_LOKI
__inputs.label: Loki
__inputs.description: Loki data source ingesting xrdmoncollect OTLP logs

title: XRootD Transfers (Loki)
description: Per-transfer detail from the xrdmoncollect OpenTelemetry log records in Loki: who moved what, how fast, and what failed. The cluster-wide rates behind these documents are in the Prometheus dashboards; dataset popularity has its own Loki dashboard.

panels.title: Bytes read
panels.description: Read volume over the dashboard window.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" | unwrap xrootd_read_bytes [$__range]))

panels.title: Bytes written
panels.description: Write volume over the dashboard window.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" | unwrap xrootd_write_bytes [$__range]))

panels.title: Transfers
panels.description: Concluded file operations.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" [$__range]))

panels.title: Failed
panels.description: Operations that concluded unsuccessfully.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" | xrootd_operation_state="Failed" [$__range]))

panels.title: Distinct clients
panels.description: Client addresses seen transferring.

targets.expr: count(sum by (client_address)(count_over_time({service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" [$__range])))

panels.title: Distinct users
panels.description: Mapped user names seen transferring.

targets.expr: count(sum by (user_name)(count_over_time({service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" [$__range])))

panels.title: Throughput (read vs write)
panels.description: Bytes per second, attributed to the moment each operation concluded rather than spread over its lifetime -- a long transfer lands entirely in the bucket where it closed.

targets.expr: sum(rate({service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" | unwrap xrootd_read_bytes [$__auto]))
sum(rate({service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" | unwrap xrootd_write_bytes [$__auto]))

panels.title: Operation duration
panels.description: How long each file operation stayed open.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.50, {service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" | unwrap xrootd_operation_duration [$__auto]) by (service_name)

quantile_over_time(0.90, {service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" | unwrap xrootd_operation_duration [$__auto]) by (service_name)

quantile_over_time(0.99, {service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" | unwrap xrootd_operation_duration [$__auto]) by (service_name)

panels.title: Bytes read per operation
panels.description: The size distribution of individual reads. A p99 far above the p50 is a few large sequential reads among many small ones.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.50, {service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" | unwrap xrootd_read_bytes [$__auto]) by (service_name)

quantile_over_time(0.90, {service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" | unwrap xrootd_read_bytes [$__auto]) by (service_name)

quantile_over_time(0.99, {service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" | unwrap xrootd_read_bytes [$__auto]) by (service_name)

panels.title: Transfers by VO
panels.description: From the client's credential. Requires the servers to send the u (user) stream.

targets.expr: sum by (xrootd_vo)(count_over_time({service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" [$__range]))

panels.title: Authentication method
panels.description: The security protocol each session authenticated with.

targets.expr: sum by (xrootd_auth_method)(count_over_time({service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" [$__range]))

panels.title: Locality (LAN vs WAN)
panels.description: Whether the client was inside the server's own domain. Present only once the client's site can be established.

targets.expr: sum by (xrootd_is_local)(count_over_time({service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" [$__range]))

panels.title: Top users by bytes read
panels.description: The twenty heaviest readers over the window.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (user_name)(sum_over_time({service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" | unwrap xrootd_read_bytes [$__range])))

panels.title: Top client sites by bytes read
panels.description: Where the read traffic came from, as advertised by the client.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (xrootd_client_site)(sum_over_time({service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" | unwrap xrootd_read_bytes [$__range])))

panels.title: Top applications by transfers
panels.description: The client executable behind each session, from the login record. Useful for telling framework traffic from interactive use.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (user_agent_name)(count_over_time({service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top files by bytes read
panels.description: The twenty most-read paths over the window.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (file_path)(sum_over_time({service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" | unwrap xrootd_read_bytes [$__range])))

panels.title: Bytes read by file extension
panels.description: Read volume by file type, which is the cheapest proxy for what kind of work the cluster is doing.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (file_extension)(sum_over_time({service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" | unwrap xrootd_read_bytes [$__range])))

panels.title: Operations by state
panels.description: Successful against failed, over the window.

targets.expr: sum by (xrootd_operation_state)(count_over_time({service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" [$__range]))

panels.title: Failed operations by kind
panels.description: Which operation was being attempted when it failed.

targets.expr: sum by (xrootd_operation_name)(count_over_time({service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" | xrootd_operation_state="Failed" [$__range]))

panels.title: Failed operations by error code
panels.description: The XRootD error code the server returned. Grouped by code rather than by error.type, which carries the full message including the path and so has one value per file.

targets.expr: sum by (xrootd_error_code)(count_over_time({service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" | xrootd_operation_state="Failed" [$__range]))

panels.title: Clean vs forced closes
panels.description: A forced close is one the collector synthesised because the client disconnected without closing the file, so its byte counts are whatever had been reported by then.

targets.expr: sum by (xrootd_forced_close)(count_over_time({service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | xrootd_operation_state=~".+" [$__auto]))

panels.title: g-stream providers
panels.description: Which plugins are sending g-stream records. Empty unless the collector runs with gstream enabled.

targets.expr: sum by (xrootd_gstream_provider)(count_over_time({service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | event_name="xrootd.gstream" [$__range]))

panels.title: Sessions over time
panels.description: Session rollups emitted on client disconnect. Empty unless the collector runs with sessions enabled.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | event_name="xrootd.session" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Session duration
panels.description: How long clients stayed connected.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.50, {service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | event_name="xrootd.session" | unwrap xrootd_session_duration [$__auto]) by (service_name)

quantile_over_time(0.90, {service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | event_name="xrootd.session" | unwrap xrootd_session_duration [$__auto]) by (service_name)

quantile_over_time(0.99, {service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | event_name="xrootd.session" | unwrap xrootd_session_duration [$__auto]) by (service_name)

panels.title: Session start resolution
panels.description: How each session's start time was established. login and connect are exact; first_activity is inferred from the first record seen, and disconnect means nothing was known, so that session's duration is reported as zero and drags the quantiles beside it down.

targets.expr: sum by (xrootd_session_start_time_source)(count_over_time({service_namespace=~"$cluster", service_name=~"$service", service_instance_id=~"$server"} | event_name="xrootd.session" [$__auto]))
